fato_historico: 1782: George Washington orders the creation of the Badge of Military Merit to honor soldiers wounded in battle. It is later renamed to the more poetic Purple Heart.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a gentle call to acknowledge your personal battles and victories. Much like the creation of a special badge for those who showed courage, consider honoring your own resilience. It is a good time to recognize the sacrifices you have made on your path to self-discovery, allowing your spirit to shine with newfound pride and quiet confidence.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in the heart that keeps beating with courage.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the search for deeper meaning in life.
conselho: Take a moment to celebrate a personal achievement with grace and gratitude today.
